from pathlib import Path
for p in sorted(Path('conf').glob('*.yaml')):
data = p.read_text()
lines = data.splitlines(keepends=True)
old = 'log_level: debug'
new = 'log_level: info'
changed = 0
out_lines = []
for line in lines:
if line.rstrip('\r\n') == old:
changed += 1
line = line.replace(old, new, 1)
out_lines.append(line)
if changed != 1:
raise SystemExit(f'{p}: expected 1 match, found {changed}')
p.write_text(''.join(out_lines))
print(f'{p}: changed {changed} line(s)')
